summary: Five-phase plan built on the research finding that the suite's apparent flake is two deterministic test-fixture-staleness defects, not lock contention. Phases 1-2 fix the two offending suites (scratch fixture repo with REPO_ROOT override for test-validate-return-meta.sh; two-file skill_cleanup contract plus a positive control for test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh), Phase 3 adds a live-specs-path lint with its own both-polarity fixture suite, Phase 4 writes the isolation rule into shell-script-testing.md, and Phase 5 executes the task's 10-consecutive-runs-under-concurrency acceptance measurement with the deploy-staleness confounder explicitly separated. No changes to task-lock.sh or run-all.sh, both reviewed and found sound.
